raw.query: WITH points AS ( SELECT image_px::double precision AS px, image_px::double precision * image_px::double precision AS area, mean_ms + 68.0 * (image_px::double precision / 448.0)^2 AS floor_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine = 'aic' AND n_images = 64 AND image_px IN (448, 672) GROUP BY image_px, mean_ms ), interp AS ( SELECT p1.px AS px1, p1.area AS area1, p1.floor_ms AS floor1, p2.px AS px2, p2.area AS area2, p2.floor_ms AS floor2 FROM points p1, points p2 WHERE p1.px = 448 AND p2.px = 672 ) SELECT SQRT(area1 + (1000.0 - floor1) / (floor2 - floor1) * (area2 - area1)) AS crossing_px FROM interp LIMIT 1;
raw.evidence: Linear area-interpolation of 100 Gbps service floor (384.4 ms at 448 px, 940.7 ms at 672 px) crosses 1000 ms SLA at 691.6 px. Assumed 448 px sits below it.
